tasks.description: Create Fast-Path Dispatcher - Implement 6-signature optimized dispatch with pre-compiled tests, cached lengths, and direct function references
Create Generic Dispatcher - Implement fallback loop dispatcher for signatures beyond fast-path, with onMismatch handler integration
Create Reference Resolver - Port resolveReferences() for typed.referTo() and typed.referToSelf() with circular reference detection
Create Main Typed Function Builder - Port createTypedFunction() with signature parsing, conflict detection, sorting, compilation, and dispatcher creation
Create Factory Function - Implement create() that produces isolated typed universes with independent type registries and conversion managers
Implement typed.find() & typed.findSignature() - Port signature lookup functions with exact match and any/rest param handling
Implement typed.resolve() - Port runtime signature resolution that returns matching signature for given arguments
Implement typed.convert() - Port value conversion function with type test and conversion chain execution
